from.place: proof, diagonal step: the diagonal of a smooth morphism is a regular immersion of codimension d

title: The diagonal of a smooth separated morphism is a regular immersion
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let f:X\to S be a smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] morphism of pure relative dimension d whose diagonal \Delta:X\to X\times_S X [def-pc-base-change] is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Then every point of X\times_S X has an affine open neighbourhood U=\operatorname{Spec}A such that the ideal I\subset A of \Delta^{-1}(U) is either A or is generated by an A-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence] f_1,\dots,f_d of length d.

source.place: Tag 067U, Lemma 31.22.11 (an immersion between schemes smooth over S is a regular immersion), applied to \Delta, a section of the smooth projection p_1 of relative dimension d
